name: Tangent Internet
summary: Victorian dialup ISP (outer-eastern Melbourne; tangnt.com.au) run by Matthew Proctor from Jan 1994; operations folded into Imagineering Technologies on his departure in Feb 1997.

events.details: Founded Jan 1994 by Matthew Proctor; became one of Victoria's largest metropolitan ISPs, serving Melbourne's outer-eastern suburbs with residential/business dial-up and web hosting (per founder's career record). Earliest verified Wayback capture of tangnt.com.au is 19 Dec 1996.

Founder Matthew Proctor departed after ~3 years (Jan 1994 - Feb 1997); Tangent's ISP operations were folded into Imagineering Technologies Pty Ltd, which he co-founded at that time. [Prior record said 'defunct c.2005' - incorrect.]
